title: Entry Level Gaming Chair
text:
Entry Level Gaming Chair. I selected this item for my son who is a gamer and spends a good bit of time in front of the computer. It’s a rocker style gaming chair, a style of chair with which I was previously unfamiliar, and I was hopeful that it would be an enjoyable accessory for him. Unfortunately, it is not as good as we had hoped and it doesn’t really meet the need. For what it is, it is acceptable at the price point.

I’ll start with the basics. It is a padded, faux leather chair with built-in Bluetooth speakers and feedback sensors for vibration response. A lot of other gaming chairs have this kind of configuration. I’ll confess to being skeptical of the vibration feedback in particular but I did not have high expectations for the speakers either (based on having worked with dozens of Bluetooth speakers over time). Instead of being a typical stand chair, this is a rocker which sits on the floor - not suitable at all for sitting at a desk. It’s reasonably lightweight and easy to move so taking it to another room is easy enough. It is bulky, though, so this is not the kind of accessory that you’d pack up and carry to a friend’s house.

Bluetooth connection is straightforward and easy and we had no issues connecting to phones, tablets or even the PC. It uses an older Bluetooth standard so there should be little issue with support. Once connected, the speakers kick in like you’d expect.

We discovered a couple of issues that make this less than ideal. First, the chair itself comes in the box and folded in half, and Velcro is used to fix the chair into a fully upright position. That’s ok, except that the Velcro is a weak point and it’s a matter of time before it weakens. The chair isn’t all that expensive so it isn’t a huge loss if the stitching around the Velcro fatigues, but be aware. Second, the speaker quality met expectations and is relatively mediocre. Finally, the vibration feedback isn’t all that effective and seems more of an afterthought.

This is not a terrible chair, but I hesitate to call it particularly good. I would call it a reasonable entry-level chair at an entry-level price.

product_metadata.title: X Rocker, 5151201, Spade Floor Rocker 2.1 with Bluetooth Audio, 29.53 x 16.9 x 28.15, Black
features: HIGH TECH GAMING CHAIR: Integrated 2.1 Bluetooth Audio System with headrest mounted speakers provides high quality audio for added immersion in video games and movies
COMPATIBLE WITH MOST SYSTEMS: Simply connect to your gaming system or device to set up
ROCKS AND RECLINES: Rocking design moves and reclines for comfortable playing positions throughout your longest gaming sessions
DURABLE SURFACE: High-quality PU printed leather surface with a camo design
PERFECT SIZE FOR YOUR GAMING SPACE: Measures 29.53 x 16.9 x 28.15 and folds down for convenient storage when not in use
description: Upgrade your gaming setup with the X Rocker Spade Floor Rocker 2.1 with Bluetooth Audio. This chair is designed with an integrated 2.1 Bluetooth Audio System with headrest mounted speakers to provide high quality audio for added immersion in video games. It is compatible with most gaming systems - just connect to your device to set up. The rocking design moves and reclines for comfortable playing positions throughout your longest gaming sessions. This versatile chair is great for use in living rooms, game rooms, bedrooms, dorm rooms, or your preferred gaming location. It is also great for watching movies, reading, and lounging, and it folds down for convenient storage when not in use. Simply wipe clean for easy care and maintenance. Measuring 29.53 x 16.9 x 28.15, this chair fits perfectly into any gaming space.
